kickback.name: KICKBACK
kickback.pitch: An Asteroids-style arena with no engine: every shot kicks you backward, so your gun is your only thruster.

loopback.name: LOOPBACK
loopback.pitch: Collect orbs while every few seconds a ghost of your own past movement replays. Your history is the bullet hell.

tiltwell.name: TILTWELL
tiltwell.pitch: A falling-block colour puzzle where you never rotate pieces. You rotate the whole well and gravity re-settles everything.

spellsnake.name: SPELLSNAKE
spellsnake.pitch: Snake where your body is the word. Eat letters, then cast a word to shrink. Longer words score more, but they keep you long.

pipwalk.name: PIPWALK
pipwalk.pitch: You are a die. Rolling is moving, and the face that lands on top is your attack. Upgrade your faces into broken combos.

mazewright.name: MAZEWRIGHT
mazewright.pitch: Tower defence with no towers to build. One core turret and a handful of walls: the path you force is your weapon.

uptempo.name: UPTEMPO
uptempo.pitch: A 4-lane rhythm highway where accuracy drives the BPM. Play perfectly and the song speeds up until you can't keep up.

compound.name: COMPOUND
compound.pitch: A whole incremental game in about 3 minutes. Build compounding adjacency combos faster than an exponential tide rises.

junkorbit.name: JUNK ORBIT
junkorbit.pitch: Slingshot comets around planets at stars. Every comet you fire stays in orbit forever, and some come back for you.

magsumo.name: MAGSUMO
magsumo.pitch: Sumo on shrinking ice where you can't push: only steer and flip your magnet's polarity. Solo CPU gauntlet, or local 2P.
